top_signals.summary: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. top_signals.title: India Economic Activity Edges Up as Services Improve
top_signals.summary: India’s economic activity edged up in August from a four-year low last month as a pick up in services offset a sharp slowdown in manufacturing, a flash survey by HSBC Holdings Plc showed Friday.

top_signals.title: T.Rowe Price's Loefstrand on Frontier Markets
top_signals.summary: Johannes Loefstrand, who manages $310 million in frontier market assets at T. Rowe Price, spoke to Bloomberg's Chief Africa Correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja on Next Africa, saying he’s “excited” about the prospects of Africa’s most-populous nation. (Source: Bloomberg)
